_comment: A chain: problems solved by the same breadth-first search, ordered so each one is one change from an earlier one. Solve them in order, in one sitting, to see the change. state = one queue entry, neighbours = how the next states are made, start = what is in the queue at level 0, seen = how visited is kept, answer = what is returned and when. Drafted 2026-09-23 from the cached solutions; the order follows cp-algorithms (BFS, 0-1 BFS), the USACO Guide (unweighted shortest paths, 0/1 BFS) and the LeetCode discuss post 'BFS and its variations' (standard, multi-source, state, 0-1).

1926.title: Nearest Exit from Entrance in Maze
1926.answer: level at the first border cell that is not the entrance, -1 if none

542.title: 01 Matrix
542.change: every 0 starts at level 0; fill every cell's distance, no target

1765.title: Map of Highest Peak
1765.change: the sources are the 1s, unseen is -1

1162.title: As Far from Land as Possible
1162.answer: last level, -1 if all land or all water
1162.change: return the largest distance, not the grid

994.title: Rotting Oranges
994.seen: mark fresh as rotten, count fresh left
994.answer: levels until no fresh is left, -1 if one is never reached
994.change: -1 if some cell is never reached

3905.title: Multi Source Flood Fill
3905.change: each source carries a colour; two colours reaching a cell in the same level, the larger wins

433.title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
433.neighbours: change one letter to A, C, G or T, keep it if in bank
433.change: states are strings, not cells: neighbours are one-letter changes found in the bank

127.title: Word Ladder
127.neighbours: change one letter to a..z, keep it if in wordList
127.answer: words on the path (level + 1) at endWord, 0 if never
127.change: 26 letters, count words not steps, 0 if never

2059.title: Minimum Operations to Convert Number
2059.neighbours: x + n, x - n, x ^ n for n in nums
2059.answer: level when goal appears, even outside 0..1000; -1 if never
2059.change: states are numbers; a value outside 0..1000 can equal goal but cannot move on

909.title: Snakes and Ladders
909.neighbours: s + 1..s + 6, then take the snake or ladder there
909.answer: level at n * n, -1 if never
909.change: neighbours are die rolls that may jump; square number to (row, col), rows alternate direction

1129.title: Shortest Path with Alternating Colors
1129.answer: per node the smaller of the two colours, -1 if both inf
1129.change: a state is (node, colour of last edge), so each node is seen twice; the next edge must be the other colour

934.title: Shortest Bridge
934.start: every cell of the first island, found by a DFS
934.answer: level at the first land cell of the other island
934.change: the sources are one island, found by a DFS first; stop at the other island

2812.title: Find the Safest Path in a Grid
2812.neighbours: 4 directions; in the check, only cells with dist >= s
2812.seen: dist grid, then a visited grid per check
2812.answer: largest s for which (0, 0) reaches (n - 1, n - 1)
2812.change: then a second BFS corner to corner through cells with dist >= s; binary search the largest s

2290.title: Minimum Obstacle Removal to Reach Corner
2290.change: edge weights 0 and 1: a step onto an obstacle costs 1 (back of a deque), onto an empty cell 0 (front)
